--- create_sequence_counter_without_options.sql
CREATE SEQUENCE IF NOT EXISTS S START COUNTER WITH 1

--- AST
&ast.CreateSequence{
  Name: &ast.Path{
    Idents: []*ast.Ident{
      &ast.Ident{
        NamePos: 30,
        NameEnd: 31,
        Name:    "S",
      },
    },
  },
  IfNotExists: true,
  Params:      []ast.SequenceParam{
    &ast.StartCounterWith{
      Start:   32,
      Counter: &ast.IntLiteral{
        ValuePos: 51,
        ValueEnd: 52,
        Base:     10,
        Value:    "1",
      },
    },
  },
}

--- SQL
CREATE SEQUENCE IF NOT EXISTS S START COUNTER WITH 1
